value.title: Claude pipeline selected proof — not execution evidence

value.criterion: An application can inject a SessionLoader and choose a pure adapter without a filesystem or CLI dependency in the adapter; the same provided native data/state/options produces the same contracted result.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: pure adapter conformance plus source scanner with explicit denied constructs/negative fixtures (guide vd0006); scanner false-negative limits named, independent source judgement complements it.
value.probe: Current main provides configfoundation only; archived workshop and scratch experiments are research, not newproductionproof.

value.criterion: The shared file loader lists candidate sessions deterministically within an explicit source scope and reads bounded native batches; it neither interprets Claude content nor implicitly scans HOME or follows out-of-scope sidecars/symlinks.
value.proof: Real temporary file-loader tests: explicit root listing, deterministic order, capacity and symlink/non-file boundaries.
value.probe: Current main provides configfoundation only; archived workshop and scratch experiments are research, not newproductionproof.

value.criterion: Batch reads support explicit caller-owned resume positions, make progress across blank lines, retain incomplete final JSONL records without advancing beyond them, and report changed/truncated/replaced sources instead of silently losing data; unsupported source identity is named.
value.proof: Loader cursor/partial-tail/blank/bounds/stale identity regressions with temporary files; no automatic unsafe reset.
value.probe: Current main provides configfoundation only; archived workshop and scratch experiments are research, not newproductionproof.

value.criterion: The Claude adapter maps user/assistant messages and supported text/reasoning/tool-call/tool-result parts, native identity/parent/session links, model and usage facts where present; repeated logical message IDs do not silently erase physical source records or fabricate a full inference operation.
value.proof: Claude sanitized fixture mappings plus repeated message-ID, mixed parts, model/usage cases.
value.probe: Current main provides configfoundation only; archived workshop and scratch experiments are research, not newproductionproof.

value.criterion: Malformed or unsupported native records/parts, absent fields and source fragments have explicit diagnostics/provenance rather than panic, guessed values or an unqualified lossless/full-session claim; malformed bytes are not echoed in public errors.
value.proof: Malformed/unknown native data and safe diagnostics contract cases; explicit fidelity counters and no raw error leakage.

value.criterion: The output writer emits valid UTF-8 OTLP LogsData JSONL with correct structured AnyValue/64-bit timestamp encoding and a documented standard-first semantic profile; native-only semantics use clearly named extensions, not invented standard attributes.
value.proof: OTLPJSONL writer conformance cases against documented LogsData/AnyValue encoding, signed64/u64timestamp/structured values and injected writer failures.

value.criterion: The SDK collection service composes loader, pure adapter and injected destination, returning a next checkpoint only after the batch is accepted by the output; output/read/map failures retain actionable error context without falsely advancing successful progress or claiming exactly-once writes.
value.proof: SDK collect_batch fake loader/adapter/output tests verify checkpoint return only after output accepted; no false exactly-once claim.

value.criterion: Content collection/export is explicit: metadata-only is the conservative default and the caller/CLI can opt into message content; omitted/redacted/unsupported content is distinguished, and attachment references are never dereferenced implicitly.
value.proof: Metadata-only and opt-in content fixture tests, include unknownparts/rawvalues only by documented policy; no attachment reads.

value.criterion: The CLI can list explicit session inputs and export a selected Claude file to stdout or an explicitly selected file using the same SDK pipeline; machine diagnostics do not corrupt OTLP stdout and file creation does not silently overwrite existing data.
value.proof: Actual installedCLI list/export stdout/file/error scenarios in sealedtemporary environments, existing configcommands unchanged.
